items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: The landlord's agent may charge you only a capped share of the visit, file, lease and inventory costs. An agent you hire is paid once the lease is signed, never before.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: The lease must state the reference rent and cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. We run the check.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month's rent unfurnished, two furnished, by law. Agents still ask for more, or months in advance. We don't let them.

items.title: Lease type
items.text: Unfurnished, furnished or bail mobilité: each sets notice, deposit and rights. We check which you're handed, and which charges are yours.

papers.summary: The papers a French landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest we go through on the free call.

items.q: When do I pay a rental agent in Paris?
items.a: Only when you sign the lease we helped you get: in France an agent may take nothing before. BOOM Paris works that way on every fare, and if you never sign, you pay nothing.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call, or before you sign a lease.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Paris from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen, and no agent before the lease is signed. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report, charged only if you sign. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the lease and the rent cap before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: Then you pay nothing: every fare is charged only when you sign the lease we helped you get. We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, six months at most.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Paris, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome. Hired and paid by the tenant only, when the lease is signed, never before.
Expats and internationals relocating to Paris — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English; the one-page presentation goes in French.
No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.
French-format dossier within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings with live video and written report, rent cap and lease checked before you sign.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't collect your rent or deposit, we don't promise a date, and we charge nothing before you sign.

footer.statement: BOOM Paris acts solely as a tenant-side search agent. We do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents, and we charge nothing before your lease is signed.
